text:
Type: angled faceted stoneware vase
Use: holding stems or branches; living room, dining room, bedroom, home office, on a console, shelf or floor
Style: modern, minimalist, contemporary
Materials: matte glazed stoneware
Colors: white
Shape: tall slender geometric form with sharp angled facets, narrowing toward the base, hexagonal mouth, sculptural
Feel: crisp, graphic, airy
Goes with: light wood, concrete, black or brass accents; minimalist, Scandinavian or modern rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Angled Stoneware Vase, 14.4"H, White
product.description: Neutral white with angled patterns allow it to blend with any room 100% stoneware with transparent glaze 4.75"Diameter x 14.4" H Durable stoneware vase great for display or holding flowers. Folds and angles bring a chic design to this contemporary stoneware vase. The lovely milky white color with transparent glaze will go with any décor. Add flowers if you wish, but this vase can also stand alone as a decorative piece.
